claim: On Linux servers and macOS computers, the metrics you can collect with the CloudWatch agent include mem_used_percent (the percentage of memory currently in use) and disk_used_percent (the percentage of total disk space that is used).

qualifiers.scope: CloudWatch agent on Linux and macOS (Windows Server uses Performance Monitor counter names)

evidence.quote: The following table lists the metrics that you can collect with the CloudWatch agent on Linux servers and macOS computers.

| `mem_used_percent` | The percentage of memory currently in use.
Unit: Percent |

| `disk_used_percent` | The percentage of total disk space that is used.
Unit: Percent |
